patterns.note: Full-bleed, high-resolution imagery and video are used extensively as primary content blocks, often spanning the entire viewport width.
A strong typographic hierarchy is established with oversized, bold sans-serif headings contrasting with smaller, lighter body text and uppercase labels.
The primary color scheme is monochromatic (black, white, and light grey), allowing vibrant project imagery to provide the main bursts of color.

The initial hero section features a video that plays on load. As the user scrolls, this video section scrolls out of view, revealing the main content. The header navigation shrinks in height and remains sticky at the top of the viewport.
Content sections frequently alternate between full-width visual elements (images/videos) and text blocks, sometimes arranged in a two-column layout with a large visual on one side.

technique_notes: The hero section utilizes a full-bleed video element that plays automatically. On scroll, this video section is designed to move upwards, allowing the subsequent content to fill the viewport. The main navigation bar at the top of the page is implemented as a sticky element that reduces its height and potentially changes its background appearance (e.g., from transparent to solid) once the user scrolls past the initial hero section.

Content sections are revealed by the natural scroll of the page, with no complex scroll-triggered animations beyond the sticky header and the hero section's scroll-out effect. Project showcases often use a grid or mosaic layout for images.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, bold sans-serif headings (~3-4x body) are used for impact, complemented by smaller, lighter body text and even smaller uppercase labels.
design_tokens.spacing: airy — generous whitespace surrounds content blocks and typography, creating a clean and open feel, especially in the hero and textual sections.

standout: This site distinguishes itself through its bold, full-bleed visual storytelling, leveraging high-quality video and photography as the primary means of engagement. The navigation is exceptionally minimal, almost disappearing to let the immersive content take center stage, creating a highly sophisticated and art-gallery-like experience.
